summary: Override an Electron special path while preserving validation and later lookup behavior.

target.notes: Validate supported names and existing-directory requirements before updating the path service.

semantics.throws: if a directory path does not exist or name is unsupported

caveats: Do not create missing directories implicitly; Electron documents that callers should create them before setPath.
The override must affect later getPath calls.

tests.name: missing directory
tests.expected_behavior: throws instead of silently accepting a nonexistent directory
